summary: 武帝第七子，平侯景称帝于江陵；承圣二年讨平武陵王纪，承圣三年西魏破江陵，城破被俘杀，聚书十四万卷焚于兵火。
summary_en: Seventh son of Emperor Wu, he destroyed Hou Jing and took the throne at Jiangling; in the 2nd year of Chengsheng he put down the Prince of Wuling, and in the 3rd year Western Wei broke Jiangling — he was taken and slain, and his library of 140,000 volumes perished in the flames.

portrait.appearance_basis: 史载「帝聪悟俊朗，目有精光」。画像宜表现好学而猜忌的君主之态，衣冠从梁代中制。属艺术想象。

timeline.title: 生
timeline.summary: 武帝第七子，字世诚，小字七符。好读书。
timeline.summary_en: Seventh son of Emperor Wu, styled Shicheng, childhood name Qifu; a lover of books.

timeline.title: 平侯景称帝
timeline.summary: 王僧辩等灭景，绎即位于江陵，改元承圣。
timeline.summary_en: Wang Sengbian and the others destroyed Jing; Yi took the throne at Jiangling and changed the era to Chengsheng.

timeline.title: 与益州萧纪相攻
timeline.summary: 武陵王纪称帝蜀中，绎讨平之。
timeline.summary_en: The Prince of Wuling, Ji, took the throne in Shu; Yi destroyed him.

timeline.title: 西魏破江陵
timeline.summary: 于谨等破江陵，俘杀元帝，尽收图籍。
timeline.summary_en: Yujin and the others broke Jiangling, took and slew the emperor, and carried off the books.

timeline.title: 金楼子与藏书
timeline.summary: 著《金楼子》，聚书十四万卷，城破多毁。
timeline.summary_en: He wrote the *Jinlouzi* and gathered 140,000 volumes, most destroyed when the city fell.

timeline.title: 元帝总评
timeline.summary: 聪悟好学，而多猜忌，失在不能早复建康。
timeline.summary_en: Sharp and studious, but jealous; his error was not returning to Jiankang in time.

relations.note: 栋禅位侯景，景败后元帝正位于江陵
relations.note_en: Xiao Dong abdicates to Hou Jing; after Jing's defeat, Emperor Yuan formally takes the throne at Jiangling

relations.note: 承圣三年江陵陷，子方智即位于建康
relations.note_en: In Chengsheng 3, Jiangling falls; his son Fangzhi takes the throne at Jiankang

bio_md:
# 梁元帝 · 主要事迹

萧绎字世诚，武帝第七子，封湘东王。少聪悟好学，「博综群书」，著《金楼子》等，聚书十四万卷，为南朝藏书之最。侯景之乱中，绎以荆州刺史之身，与王僧辩等讨伐侯景；承圣元年，王僧辩克建康、平侯景，绎即位于江陵，改元承圣——梁室中兴，然都于江陵而不还建康，为后来之祸。

元帝在位三年：承圣二年，武陵王萧纪称帝蜀中，元帝遣军讨平之；然其猜忌骨肉，杀其兄邵陵王纶，兄弟相残之惨，甚于侯景。承圣三年，西魏遣于谨等五路南下，破江陵；元帝出降，旋被俘杀，年四十七。城破之时，元帝「尽焚图书」，十四万卷典籍付之一炬——「江陵焚书」，为中国文化史上最大浩劫之一。

元帝聪悟好学而多猜忌，史评「失在不能早复建康」：侯景乱平，梁室应以建康为本，而元帝偏安江陵、自残骨肉，终致西魏乘虚而入。梁之亡，不亡于侯景，而亡于元帝之猜忌与短视；江陵之火，更烧尽了南朝百余年的文化积累。

> 参考：点校本《梁书》卷005《元帝纪》、周书卷015《于谨传》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Xiao Yi, styled Shicheng, was the seventh son of Emperor Wu, enfeoffed Prince of Xiangdong. Sharp and studious from youth, "learned in all the books," he wrote the *Jinlouzi* and gathered a library of 140,000 volumes — the greatest collection of the southern courts. In the Hou Jing storm, as Governor of Jingzhou, he joined Wang Sengbian against Jing; in the 1st year of Chengsheng Sengbian took Jiankang and destroyed Hou Jing, and Yi took the throne at Jiangling, changing the era to Chengsheng — the restoration of Liang, but a restoration seated at Jiangling instead of Jiankang, and that was the seed of disaster.

Three years he reigned: in the 2nd year of Chengsheng his brother the Prince of Wuling, Xiao Ji, took the throne in Shu, and Yuan destroyed him; but his jealousy of his kin was worse than Hou Jing's — he slew his brother the Prince of Shaoling, and the family slaughter outdid the rebellion. In the 3rd year of Chengsheng Western Wei sent Yujin and the others south on five roads and broke Jiangling; the emperor surrendered and was taken and slain, aged forty-seven. As the city fell, Yuan "burned all his books" — 140,000 volumes in one fire: the Jiangling book-burning, one of the great calamities of Chinese culture.

Sharp and studious but steeped in jealousy, the historians say "his error was not returning to Jiankang in time": with the rebellion ended, the Liang house should have stood on Jiankang, but Yuan hugged Jiangling and slew his kin until Western Wei struck through the gap. Liang fell not to Hou Jing but to Yuan's jealousy and his short sight; and the fire of Jiangling burned away the culture that a hundred years of the southern courts had built.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Liangshu*, ch. 5 ("Benji of Emperor Yuan"), and the *Zhoushu*, ch. 15 (biography of Yujin).
